strategy_board.title: Pre-commit execution monitor benchmark
strategy_board.thesis: Benchmark whether latent futures, VLA progress probes, and abstention signals can veto robot actions before irreversible contact or wrong-route commitment.
strategy_board.one_week: Collect short contact-rich episodes with planned action chunks, residual-stream progress traces, and manually labeled pre-contact failure windows.
strategy_board.four_week: Compare ContactGuard-style latent futures, task-progress probes, and VLM abstention gates on identical object, viewpoint, and occlusion shifts.
strategy_board.success: At least one monitor blocks a failing action with usable lead time while keeping false aborts below a predeclared threshold.
strategy_board.stop: Signals fire only after contact, collapse under unseen objects, or cannot identify which action should be blocked.
strategy_board.asset: Pre-contact clips, action chunks, latent-future traces, progress-probe logs, abstention labels, and veto outcomes.

strategy_board.title: Active embodied evidence harness
strategy_board.thesis: Turn affordance, navigation, and semantic radiance-field tasks into a harness where every extra view must justify a target, route, or interaction change.
strategy_board.one_week: Create two Habitat or reconstructed scenes with hidden functional cues, ambiguous object labels, and free-space or semantic query logs.
strategy_board.four_week: Evaluate FUSE-style active views, SAP-Nav hierarchy, SRF simulators, and humanoid VLN routes under occlusion and embodiment constraints.
strategy_board.success: The harness identifies which observation changed a grounded target, stop decision, route, or contact plan before task success is known.
strategy_board.stop: Extra views improve confidence text but do not change executable decisions or reduce failure in hidden-cue scenes.
strategy_board.asset: Viewpoint-action traces, semantic-geometric evidence maps, route decisions, target masks, and embodiment-specific failure labels.

strategy_board.title: Human-to-robot synthetic data audit
strategy_board.thesis: Test generated manipulation videos by functional contact and embodiment transfer before using them as robot-training data.
strategy_board.one_week: Select one handover and one tool-use family, then label task events, contact moments, object responses, and robot embodiment constraints.
strategy_board.four_week: Compare H2R-Bench dimensions, DreamX-Phi action-conditioned futures, and RGB-D handover generation against downstream policy imitation.
strategy_board.success: Generated data improves policy behavior only when functional contact and embodiment correctness metrics also improve.
strategy_board.stop: Video realism increases while contact timing, gripper geometry, or object response stays wrong.
strategy_board.asset: Human videos, robot embodiment manifests, generated RGB-D clips, contact-transfer labels, and policy-learning deltas.
